Arduino's official About page names Massimo Banzi, David Cuartielles, Tom Igoe, and David Mellis as co-founders. Its purpose was to lower the barrier between electronics and programming by making sensor-and-actuator projects approachable with an affordable board. Arduino is used in prototypes, education, measurement instruments, and IoT devices; it connects to careers in embedded development, electronics prototyping, and test engineering.
